items.title: Take a Chem
items.detail: Get Chems from the Doctor's Orders Cigarette Machine in your C.A.M.P. or another player's C.A.M.P., then consume them.

items.title: Collect Mothman Eggs
items.detail: Harvest from a C.A.M.P. Mothman Nest or near the large Mothman statue in southwest Point Pleasant.

items.title: Complete the Event: "The Mothman Equinox"
items.detail: Fast travel to Point Pleasant when the event is active on the map.

items.title: Kill Cultists during The Mothman Equinox event
items.detail: Use area-of-effect weapons like Tesla Rifles to tag multiple enemies during the event.

items.title: Kill a Cryptid with a Bow or Crossbow
items.detail: Fast travel to Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go where up to three Snallygasters can spawn.

items.title: Sell Mothman Egg Omelette to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Craft omelette using one Mothman Egg and one Wood at any cooking station.

items.title: Sell Ribeye Steak to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Kill a Brahmin, then cook Ribeye Steak using one Brahmin Meat and one Wood.

items.title: Collect Energy Ammo
items.detail: Take some from your stash, craft at a Tinker's Workbench, or loot from enemies killed with energy weapons.

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Use a Games Cupboard at your C.A.M.P. to collect board games like Blast Radius or Autopsy.

items.title: Destroy Robots with an Energy Weapon
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center and use energy weapons like Laser Rifles or Plasma Guns.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center for dependable robot spawns.

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Harvest from wild locations or plant vegetable plants in your C.A.M.P. to gather on demand.

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Join a Head Hunt at Highway Town's Last Resort; the Slasher appears as an uninvited guest in the final stage.

items.title: Sell Pumpkin Pie to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Buy from Mr Waiter or Ms Waitress at Whitespring Resort dining area, or find one at Pumpkin House.

items.title: Sell a Weapon to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Sell any looted weapon or inexpensively crafted grenades to any NPC vendor.

items.title: Visit another Player's Shelter
items.detail: Fast travel to another player's C.A.M.P. and enter their Shelter; look for camps with radiation symbol icons.

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Earn the daily Gold Star on three separate days during the week.
